name: Selectable table
summary: A dense table with row checkboxes, status pills and a bar of bulk actions that appears, with a live count, as soon as a row is picked.
use: for dense lists people review and act on in bulk
a11y: Each checkbox is named after its row and has a 24 px target; the bulk bar is a labelled toolbar whose count is a polite live region; the table scrolls sideways in its own box on narrow screens.

use_when: matching bank lines, invoices or shipments where each row has a status and several rows get the same action
avoid_when: one item that needs a decision with its policy and steps: use approval-panel
a read-only history of changes: use audit-log
a short list with no bulk actions: use activity-list

parts.name: summary
parts.what: how many rows, where from, and their total

parts.name: columns
parts.what: column headers: select, customer, reference, amount, match

parts.name: rows
parts.what: one row: checkbox, customer, reference, amount and status

parts.name: select
parts.what: a checkbox named after its row

parts.name: reference
parts.what: the other side's reference, in code type; hidden in a narrow box

parts.name: amount
parts.what: the amount, right-aligned, with its currency

parts.name: status
parts.what: the row's match status as a coloured pill with a word

parts.name: bulk_count
parts.what: how many rows are picked; updates as rows are ticked

empty.how: the Smart UI renderer puts one plain 'Nothing to show yet.' line in an empty list

loading.how: the Smart UI renderer draws each marked slot as a quiet block of its size while the data arrives; the static file shows the filled part

error.how: if a bulk action fails, keep the rows ticked and show the reason in toast-stack or an alert-banners line above the table

disabled.how: set disabled on the checkbox of a row that cannot be acted on and dim it; set disabled on both bulk buttons while an action runs

overflow.how: the table scrolls sideways in its own box when its columns do not fit, and in a narrow box each row becomes a stacked card

long_text.how: cells never wrap in the table layout; in a narrow box they wrap and the bulk buttons end in an ellipsis
long_text.evidence: white-space: nowrap; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis;

keyboard: Tab reaches each row's checkbox in turn, then the bulk buttons once a row is picked
Space ticks or unticks the focused checkbox, and the bulk count updates
Enter or Space presses the focused bulk button
